def split_labels(labels):
    return [labels[i:i + 3] for i in range(0, len(labels), 3)]

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from labels import split_labels

assert split_labels([]) == []
assert split_labels(["A", "B", "C", "D"]) == [["A", "B", "C", "D"]]
assert split_labels(list("ABCDEFGHI")) == [list("ABCD"), list("EFGH"), list("I")]
